message: No detected input validation: There is no schema check, dtype assertion, or value-range guard applied to incoming data in any of the data-acquisition code paths shown.
No detected untrusted source handling: No checksum verification, signed URLs, pinned revisions, or source authentication is performed when fetching data from any remote source in the code shown.

No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering applied to training samples in any of the visible data preparation code.
No detected model integrity verification: No hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed when loading serialized models or pretrained weights anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are referenced or implemented anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation in the provided code.

No detected input sanitization: The /predict endpoint uses argparse for CLI defaults and passes data directly to preprocessing/predictor stages with no visible shape, range, schema, or malformed-input validation on the incoming request payload.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or sanity thresholds before returning results to the caller.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline is a tabular ML model (Scania truck failures), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
